ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Photography is Universal. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Cameras are everywhere, from cell phones to expensive digital cameras. Photography can be used to bridge the gap between languages and cultures. This class will explore the limitless possibilities of digital photography: how it can help the individual represent their unique and important visions of beauty, truth, life, as well as other complex messages. Students in this hands-on photography class will be provided with cameras and no prior experience is needed. Assignments will include taking pictures, printing them, preparing them for the web and producing a portfolio of work from the semester.
